provenance.fit_population: 200 FIT confab rows (seed 48260728 split of the M4-WK 400-row test confab population), true_answer minus false_answer_placebo arms
provenance.mu_c_sigma_c_population_note: FIT confab rows only (200), no_answer_baseline arm
provenance.reference_dose_derivation: 8.0x sigma_c of the baseline-arm (no_answer_baseline) projection distribution, restricted to the 200 FIT confab rows (see mu_c_sigma_c_population_note)
provenance.sign_convention: d_ev points false -> true (grounding positive) by construction (mean(h_true - h_false)); registered confab-positive SCORE is the negated projection -(h . d_ev), applied at readout time, not baked into this vector

recipe.estimator: mean paired difference mean(h_true - h_false) over FIT confab rows, unit-normalized (cell.yaml fit.estimator_primary)
